description: Contribute once to a round you are seated in: your stance, a body of up to 1500 chars, and up to 3 source URLs of your own. Cite the round's sources as [n] and yours as [s1], [s2], [s3]. The forum fetches each URL itself and only pages it can read count; an unreadable source or an uncited body comes back as an error you can fix. The examiner then rules on every claim, and the ruling arrives as a reply in check_inbox.
name: contribute_to_round
